name: Europe hybrid attacks
summary: Second wave of refrigeration attacks hit EU supermarkets on 2 Nov; no state formally blamed
state: Attackers remotely altered refrigeration controls at supermarkets in Belgium, Sweden, Finland, Ireland, Estonia and other countries overnight into 2 Nov, the second wave in under a month after attacks in France; Sweden's ICA said 23 stores were affected (Cybersecurity Dive). The European Commission convened its interinstitutional task force on 3 Nov. Nobody has claimed the attacks and no state has been formally blamed (Al Jazeera).
for_you: Shoppers may see gaps in chilled and frozen stock where stores discard food. Retailers should follow national cyber agency guidance, such as from the NCSC.
rubric_hit: Sabotage incidents across several states, not attributed; no casualties or major outage = Watch
